prompt: 我已经有 RetainPDF-style artifacts-manifest 了，请用 project-wiki 规划怎么把这些 normalized sources 接成知识库；先不要 OCR、转换、复制或写文件。
expected_route: Import / Normalize Sources / P4.2 source normalization import planning.
must_not: run OCR, PDF conversion, RetainPDF, unzip, copy, move, import, or upload actions
install dependencies or execute adapter commands
guess manifest paths or scan for PDFs outside explicit configuration
read normalized document body contents beyond manifest/path metadata
write source registry files, wiki files, knowledge objects, admin logs, backups, or normalized materials
mark planned registry entries as already imported
checks: selects P4.2 source normalization import planning route
consumes explicit RetainPDF-style manifest/readiness evidence only
classifies manifest artifacts into import candidates and excluded items with reasons
proposes source registry/wiki connection as planned-only with willWrite false
keeps readOnly true and all execution/write/apply flags false
includes risks, warnings, non-goals, and confirmation gates before durable KB writes
